title: Redox-active conductive carrier enables direct electron transfer in anaerobic biofilms
description: we reported the development of a redox-active conductive carrier composed of carbon felt functionalized with tannic acid-modified iron-biochar (TA-FeBC) with superior surface wettability, which markedly enhanced direct electron transfer (DET) within anaerobic biofilms. This study provides the first integrated experimental evidence for CytC-mediated DET enabled by an engineered conductive carrier, offering a fundamentally new approach to boost anaerobic methanogenic performance.
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from sludge metagenome
